injuries.note: Casparius underwent UCL reconstruction surgery on his right elbow Wednesday.

injuries.name: Gavin Stone
injuries.note: Stone (shoulder/biceps) resumed his rehab assignment with Triple-A Oklahoma City on Wednesday, allowing three runs over two-thirds of an inning.

injuries.name: Will Klein
injuries.note: Klein underwent surgery to remove bone chips in his right elbow Wednesday.

injuries.name: Dalton Rushing
injuries.note: Rushing will undergo a hybrid internal brace procedure on his right elbow Wednesday, Maddie Lee of the Los Angeles Times reports.
